summary.text: Submit a request to reassess your household and/or means information through the MediShield Life e-Service.

details.heading: After you submit
details.body: MOH will contact you if more information is needed.

details.heading: Another way to ask
details.body: You may call the hotline instead.

steps.name: Submit a reassessment request
steps.text: Submit your request through the MediShield Life e-Service.

example_phrasings: How can I have my means test reassessed?
I was sent to MediShield Life for a higher subsidy
Can I ask for a review of my subsidy result?

sources.page_title: I am applying for subsidy from another healthcare scheme, but was directed to approach MediShield Life. What can I do to have my means-test result reassessed so that I can be eligible for higher subsidy?

quotes.text: To reassess your household and/or means information for MediShield Life Premium Subsidies and/or other selected healthcare schemes, please submit your request via the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg/).
We will contact you if we require further clarification on your request.
Alternatively, you may wish to call the hotline at 1800-222-3399.
